title: Adopted Budget 2026–2030
table: Appendix B: New Capital Works Expenditure – Years 1 to 5
units: Australian dollars, nominal budget allocations; not actual expenditure
scope: Six selected recurring programs within the Transport category, including walking, road safety and planning as well as cycling. Not the entire council transport budget or a cycling-only total.
processing: Manually transcribed annual columns for 2026-27 through 2030-31, checked against PDF text and rendered tables.
Dashes in these expenditure cells are encoded as zero planned allocation, not missing observations.
All six selected rows have no carry-forward allocation. The carry-forward column is excluded.
Bump chart calculates competition rank within these six programs each year; equal amounts share a rank.
Treemap sums the five annual amounts by program; total $14,242,654.
